jung-association-reading.title: Experimental Researches
jung-association-reading.author: C. G. Jung
jung-association-reading.reference: CW 2, “The Associations of Normal Subjects” and “The Association Method”; reaction times and disturbances in association experiments. Institutional abstracts of the primary work.

jung-dream-context-reading.title: The Structure and Dynamics of the Psyche
jung-dream-context-reading.author: C. G. Jung
jung-dream-context-reading.reference: CW 8, “General Aspects of Dream Psychology” and “On the Nature of Dreams”; individual context, associations, and interpretation.

jung-dream-series-reading.title: The Structure and Dynamics of the Psyche
jung-dream-series-reading.author: C. G. Jung
jung-dream-series-reading.reference: CW 8, “On the Nature of Dreams,” §§530–569; dream series and the testing of interpretations over time.

jung-archetype-pattern-reading.title: The Archetypes and the Collective Unconscious
jung-archetype-pattern-reading.author: C. G. Jung
jung-archetype-pattern-reading.reference: CW 9i, “Psychological Aspects of the Mother Archetype,” §155; archetype as form rather than a fixed inherited picture.

jung-collective-unconscious-reading.title: The Archetypes and the Collective Unconscious
jung-collective-unconscious-reading.author: C. G. Jung
jung-collective-unconscious-reading.reference: CW 9i, “The Concept of the Collective Unconscious,” §§87–110. Inherited dispositions distinguished from personal recollections.

jung-four-functions-reading.title: Psychological Types
jung-four-functions-reading.author: C. G. Jung
jung-four-functions-reading.reference: CW 6, chapter X, “General Description of the Types,” and chapter XI, definitions Feeling, Function, Intuition, Sensation, Thinking. Historical theory of orientation.

jung-introversion-reading.title: Psychological Types
jung-introversion-reading.author: C. G. Jung
jung-introversion-reading.reference: CW 6, chapter X, “The Introverted Type”; chapter XI, definition Introversion. Subjective orientation distinguished from social shyness.

jung-extraversion-reading.title: Psychological Types
jung-extraversion-reading.author: C. G. Jung
jung-extraversion-reading.reference: CW 6, chapter X, “The Extraverted Type”; chapter XI, definition Extraversion. Object-oriented attitude distinguished from social volume.

jung-inferior-function-reading.title: Psychological Types
jung-inferior-function-reading.author: C. G. Jung
jung-inferior-function-reading.reference: CW 6, chapter X, differentiation of conscious and unconscious functions; chapter XI, definitions Function and Inferior Function.

jung-dream-levels-reading.title: Psychological Types
jung-dream-levels-reading.author: C. G. Jung
jung-dream-levels-reading.reference: CW 6, chapter XI, definitions Objective Level and Subjective Level. Compare CW 8, “General Aspects of Dream Psychology.”
